product_story.problemEyebrow: Why data quality matters to the business
product_story.problemTitle: Poor ERP data rarely appears as one major incident.
product_story.problemLead: It creates recurring rework, slows processes, weakens reporting, and consumes capacity across finance, sales, purchasing, and operations.
problems: Teams repeatedly correct avoidable master-data, pricing, and document issues.
Incomplete setup and inconsistent data block posting, approvals, and downstream processes.
Incorrect or fragmented data distorts KPIs, forecasts, and management decisions.
Pricing deviations, duplicates, and bank-data issues increase financial and organizational effort.
product_story.impactNote: Illustrative example. The actual BCSentinel evaluation is based on detected findings and transparently disclosed model assumptions.
product_story.lossTitle: From a detected data issue to understandable business impact.
product_story.lossLead: BCSentinel clearly separates directly measured scan values from model assumptions. This shows which values come from Business Central and which parameters support the economic assessment.
product_story.frequency: Relevant events per record and year
product_story.disclaimer: Estimated Loss is a modeled decision-support value, not a guarantee of realized or avoidable cost.
product_story.howTitle: From technical ERP data to prioritized management decisions.
product_story.howLead: The customer journey stays lightweight while creating a defensible connection between data quality, business impact, and concrete action.
steps: The extension identifies tenant, environment, and company in a controlled way.
Module-specific checks detect data and configuration risks.
Findings are classified by severity, scale, and business relevance.
Teams receive recommendations, document exceptions, and track improvement.
product_story.lifeTitle: Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring form one connected data-health journey.
product_story.lifeLead: Assessment unlocks the complete analysis for seven days, Validation confirms remediation with a follow-up scan, and Monitoring keeps data quality under continuous control.

products.title: Assessment

products.title: Monitoring

product_proof.findTitle: From a technical finding to prioritized action.
product_proof.findLead: BCSentinel connects severity, affected records, Estimated Loss, and concrete recommendations in one defensible decision view.
product_proof.detailText: Multiple vendors use identical bank details. This increases control effort and risk in the payment process.
product_proof.recommendText: Review bank details, consolidate duplicates, and mark documented exceptions where appropriate.
product_proof.reportTitle: A report management can actually use.
product_proof.reportLead: The Executive Report translates scan results into score, business impact, priorities, and next steps without overwhelming readers with technical raw data.
product_proof.dashboardTitle: One central view of health, risk, and progress.
product_proof.dashboardLead: Overview, Findings, and Monitoring work together so teams can see not only issues, but also their development and remediation status.
product_proof.sample: Representative product preview using sample data.

security.title: Controlled access instead of generic security claims.
security.lead: BCSentinel separates tenant, environment, and company context, evaluates authorization on the server, and exposes protected content only for the active access mode.
steps: The extension transmits the registered tenant, environment, and company context through secured API connections.
The server builds an authoritative access snapshot and decides access to dashboard, findings, reports, scans, and monitoring.
Access snapshots are cached only briefly. Protected content is checked against the current product state.
Free preview, Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring receive different rights and durations.
cards: Tenant, environment, and company are evaluated together.
Access decisions are not derived from visible UI state alone.
Foreign tenant or company contexts are rejected server-side.
Assessment and Validation open time-limited full access.
Monitoring rights apply only during an active term.
Scan runs use defined lifecycle states.
Execution tokens, heartbeats, and recovery protect active processing.
Administrative and product decisions are modeled for traceability.
security.note: This section describes the currently implemented technical architecture. It does not replace an individual security, privacy, or contractual review. No unsupported certifications, Microsoft partnerships, or guaranteed protection outcomes are claimed.

audience.faqTitle: The most important questions before the first scan.
faq: What does the free scan show?
The free scan provides a permanent limited preview of dashboard, issues, actions, and Executive Report. Full record details and monitoring capabilities remain locked.
Assessment unlocks the already generated Full Analysis for seven days. It does not include an additional scan credit.
Validation includes one new scan credit. After the new scan, the refreshed complete analysis is available for another seven days.
What is additionally included in Monitoring?
Monitoring includes the complete analysis plus scheduled scans, history, trends, comparison views, exceptions, and additional monitoring capabilities during the active monthly or annual term.
BCSentinel separates directly measured values from model assumptions. The complete methodology and worked examples are available on the Estimated Loss examples page.

BCSentinel processes the registered tenant, environment, and company context plus configuration, result, and metadata required for scans, findings, dashboard, and reports. Details are provided in Security and Privacy.
Is BCSentinel already available in AppSource?
AppSource is in preparation. The current flow is intended for pilot and direct customer onboarding.
The free scan is started from the BCSentinel extension in Business Central. Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring are also activated from there.
audience.finalTitle: See which data issues truly deserve priority first.
audience.finalText: Start with the free scan, review the limited result preview, and unlock the complete analysis only when the business case is convincing.
audience.footerClaim: Data Health Management for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
audience.footerNote: Customer access and product activation take place through the BCSentinel extension in Business Central.
